title: Deployment Procedure
content: Production deployments require code review, automated tests, approval from the engineering lead, and a rollback plan.

title: Leave Policy
content: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave. Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal and approved by their manager.

title: Release Procedure
content: Software releases require automated regression tests, release notes, a designated release owner, and monitoring after deployment.

title: Expense Reimbursement
content: Employees must submit expense receipts within 30 days. Finance reviews claims and reimburses approved expenses through payroll.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: Remote work requires manager approval. Employees must use company-managed devices and follow corporate data protection policies.

title: Production Security Review
content: The engineering team must complete a security review before every production release.
